prompts.text: Name a TV show that's rated 8.5+ on IMDb (1,000+ votes)

items.quip: Ten hour-long films, one for each of the Ten Commandments.
items.title: Dekalog
items.description: 1989 Film cycle directed by Krzysztof Kieślowski
items.extract: Dekalog is a 1989 Polish psychological drama television miniseries directed by Krzysztof Kieślowski and co-written by Kieślowski with Krzysztof Piesiewicz, with music by Zbigniew Preisner. It consists of ten one-hour films, inspired by the decalogue of the Ten Commandments. Each installment explores characters facing one or several moral or ethical dilemmas as they reside in an austere housing project in 1980s Poland.

items.quip: College lacrosse's top player in 2019, then he switched sports.
items.title: Pat Spencer
items.extract: Patrick Andrew Spencer is an American professional basketball player for the Phoenix Suns of the National Basketball Association (NBA), on a two-way contract with the Valley Suns of the NBA G League. He played college lacrosse for the Loyola Greyhounds, where he set the NCAA men's lacrosse record for career assists (231) and is considered one of the greatest college lacrosse players of all time. He also played one year of college basketball for the Northwestern Wildcats.

prompts.text: Name a food you have to shell or crack open before eating

items.quip: Baked inside lotus leaves and clay, then cracked open with a mallet.
items.title: Beggar's chicken
items.extract: Beggar's chicken is a Chinese dish of chicken that is stuffed, wrapped in clay and lotus leaves, and baked slowly using low heat. Preparation of a single portion may take up to six hours. Although the dish is traditionally prepared with clay, the recipe has evolved; for convenience and safety it is often baked with dough, oven bags, ceramic cooking pots, or convection ovens.

prompts.text: Name a vehicle that doesn't travel on wheels

items.quip: Soviet engineers built one nicknamed the Caspian Sea Monster.
items.title: Ground-effect vehicle
items.description: Special vehicle to fly in air just above sea or ground
items.extract: A ground-effect vehicle (GEV), ekranoplan, wing-in-ground-effect, ground-effect craft/machine (GEM), wingship, flarecraft, or surface effect vehicle, is a hybrid surface vehicle/aircraft that makes use of wings to generate minimal lift and ground effect, to reduce aerodynamic drag. Ground effect is the interaction between a moving wing and a stationary surface below it.

items.quip: Ice yachts can sail several times faster than the wind.
items.title: Iceboat
items.extract: An iceboat is a recreational or competition sailing craft supported on metal runners for traveling over ice. One of the runners is steerable. Originally, such craft were boats with a support structure, riding on the runners and steered with a rear blade, as with a conventional rudder. As iceboats evolved, the structure became a frame with a seat or cockpit for the iceboat sailor, resting on runners. Steering was shifted to the front.

prompts.text: Name a body part people have exactly one of (like the nose)

items.quip: Before you were born, this carried blood from the placenta.
items.title: Round ligament of liver
items.description: Attaches the liver to the abdominal wall
items.extract: The round ligament of the liver, ligamentum teres or ligamentum teres hepatis is a ligament that forms part of the free edge of the falciform ligament of the liver. It connects the liver to the umbilicus. It is the remnant of the left umbilical vein. The round ligament divides the left part of the liver into medial and lateral sections.

prompts.text: Name a country that borders Greece or Austria

items.quip: One of only two doubly landlocked countries, with Uzbekistan.
items.title: Liechtenstein
items.extract: Liechtenstein, officially the Principality of Liechtenstein, is a doubly landlocked country in the Central European Alps. A microstate, it is located between Austria to the east and north-east and Switzerland to the north-west, west and south.

items.quip: Qatar Airways lets passengers buy cabin space for their falcons.
